No. S 4

CONSTITUTION OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM

PROCLAMATION OF EMERGENCY SEAL

HIS MAJ STY THE SULTAN

AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM ln the name of ALLAH, the Compassionate, the MercifuIf PRAISE be to ALLAHI the Lord of th e Universe, and may the benediction and peace of ALLAH be upon Our Leader Muhammad an d upon all his Relations an d Friends. WHEREAS it is provided under Clause of Article 83 of the Constitution of Brunei Darussalam (hereinafter referred to as "the Constitution")f that whenever it appears to His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan that an occasion of emergency or public danger is imminent, exists or has arisen whereby the security or economic life Of Brunei Darussalam, or any part thereof, is or may be threatened, whether by war or external aggression or internal disturbance, actual or threatenedr he may by Proclamation (hereinafter referred to as a "Proclamation of Emergency") declare a state of emergency either in the whole of Brunei Darussalam or in such part Of Brunei Darussalam as may be specified in the Proclamation of Emergency; AND WHEREAS on the 6th. day of Safar, the Hijriah of the Prophet (on Whom be the benediction and peace of ALLAH) one thousand four hundred and twenty-seven corresponding to the 6th. day of March , year two thousand and s ix 27 1

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE of th e Christian Erag we did DECLARE AND PROCLAIM a state of emergency in the whol e St at e of Brunei DarussaIam; AND WHEREAS it is provided under Clause ( 2 ) of ArticIe 83 of the Constitution that no Proclamation Of Emergency sh all be in forc e for more than 2 years, without prejudice, however, to the right of His Majesty th e SuItan and Yang Di-Pertuan to issue another such Proclamation at or before the end Of that period; AND WHEREAS it is provided under CIause 《 2A ) of Article 83 of the Constitution that notwithstanding Clause ( 2 ) of Article 83 of the Constitution, His Majesty the SuItan and Yang Di-Pertuan may by another such Proclamation declare the cessation Of a state Of emergency in the whole Of Brunei Darussalam or in such part Of Brunei Darussalam as may be specified in the Proclamation before the end of 2 years ; AN D WHEREAS it app e ars to US that an occasion of emergency or public danger IS lmminentl exists or has arisen whereby the security or economic life Of Brunei Darussalam , or any part thereof, is or may be threatened NOW, THEREFOREf WE , SULTAN HAJI HASSANAL BOLKIAH MU'IZZADDIN WADDAULAH IBNI AL-MARHUM SULTAN HAJI OMAR 'ALI

SAIFUDDIEN SAADUL KHAIRI WADDIEN, SOVE REI GN AND CHIEF OF THE FAMILY ORDER OF THE C ROWN OF BRUNEI, Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan of the State and Territory of Brunei Darussalam and all its Dependencies; Do hereby DECLARE AND PROCLAIM as of this day a state of emergency in the whole Of Brunei Darussalam AND do hereby REVOKE our said recited ProcIamation of Emergency done on the 6th. day of S afar, the Hij riah of the Prophet ()n Whom be the benediction an d peace of ALLAH ) one thousand fo ur hundred and twenty-seven corresponding to the 6th. day of March, year two thousand an d s ix of the Christian Era. So be it. Such is the ProcIamation of Emergency. May ALLAH to Whom be praise and Whose name be exalt ed the King of Kings, vouchsafe His grace an d may the Prophet Muhammad ()n Whom be the benediction an d peace of ALLAH ) grant His BIessings to this ProcIamation. Amen! O Lord of the Universe. 28 21st. JANUARY , 2008 Done at the lstana Nurul lman, Brunei Darussalam this 6th. day of Muharram t he Hij riah of the Prophet ()n Whom be the benediction an d peace of ALLAH) one thousand four hundred and twenty-nine corresponding to the 15th. d ay of January, year two thousand and eight of the Christian Eraj being the forty-first year of Our Reign ,

BY COMMAND

DATIN PADUKA DAYANG HAJAH SALBIAH BINTI

HAJI SULAIMAN Permanent Secretaryt Prime Minister s Office Brunei Darussalam. 29
